description: Splits a polyphonic input across sixteen outputs, each output monophonic, polyphonic or silent according to the routing mode.

params.text: Steps the routing mode through Single, Dynamic Below, Dynamic Above and Custom.

inputs.text: A trigger randomises the stored custom routes, following the randomisation choices on the menu; each channel of a polyphonic trigger randomises the matching output.

outputs.text: Carries the input channels that the active routing mode gives it, as a monophonic or a polyphonic signal.

notes: in Single mode each output carries the input channel of its own number, on its own.
in Dynamic Below a connected output carries the input channels from its own number as far as the next connected output, running to the end of the input's channels when there is no later one.
in Dynamic Above a connected output carries the input channels from the previous connected output as far as its own number.
in Custom mode each output carries its stored route, which can hold anything from no input channels to all sixteen.
in Custom mode, clicking an output's row opens that route for editing, where the yellow boxes are the input channels it carries.
in Custom mode, right-clicking an output's row opens a field where its route is typed, with 1 to 9 for those channels, 0 for channel 10, and a to f for channels 11 to 16.
menu: Set Custom Routing to — copies the Single, Dynamic Below or Dynamic Above routing into the stored custom routes without changing the mode in use.
Input Pool — sets which input channels randomisation may draw from in Custom mode: Only active input channels or All input channels.
Routing Mode — Single, Dynamic Below, Dynamic Above or Custom, the same setting as the mode button on the panel.
Replacement — sets how randomisation picks channels in Custom mode: With replacement, Without replacement or Shuffle existing.
Channel Count — sets how long a randomised route is in Custom mode: Same channels as current or Random channels.
Output Targets — sets which outputs randomisation changes in Custom mode: Only connected outputs or All outputs.
